title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.288 (Oct 2) ships a broad reliability update with smarter resume and recovery; 2.1.287 introduced Claude Mods
bullets.summary: Latest tracked Claude Code releases focus on resume/recovery flows, plus Claude Mods and plugin/MCP behavior improvements.
bullets.how: The Construct: resume/recovery matters for long-running scheduled agents like Pulse; Mods (hot-reloading plugin hooks) could host dashboard panes. PRAGMA: reliability talking point for client Claude Code rollouts. Brand 9: no direct use.

bullets.title: Blackstone-led syndicate assembling $60B of Broadcom AI-chip financing tied to Anthropic, with notes convertible into Anthropic equity (Oct 2)
bullets.summary: A banking syndicate is gathering $42B senior and $18B junior tranches, with convertibles into Anthropic equity, signaling continued massive compute buildout.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: supports a 'vendor stability and capacity' argument when advising clients to standardize on Claude. The Construct and Brand 9: no direct use.

bullets.title: Google cuts Gemini free access to a single model on Oct 9
bullets.summary: Free Gemini users lose Flash and Pro access from October 9, per multiple outlets.
bullets.how: The Construct: audit any agent or workflow that relies on free-tier Gemini before Oct 9 and move it to a paid key or another model. PRAGMA: a cautionary example of free-tier dependency risk for clients. Brand 9: no direct use.

bullets.title: arXiv 2610.02525 MIRA: meta-reasoning for iterative research agents
bullets.summary: Separates research-allocation decisions from execution, using an outer-loop meta-reasoner to curate context and write work orders for long-horizon autonomous research.
bullets.how: The Construct: matches our orchestrator-writes-work-orders pattern for Scout/Pulse-style research agents. PRAGMA: citable architecture for research-agent engagements.

bullets.title: Cua Spaces lets agents operate personal desktops or cloud machines with permissions and sign-in management (Oct 2)
bullets.summary: Source-available driver access and managed permissions for computer-use agents on a person's own desktop.
bullets.how: The Construct: a comparison point for our computer-use and Hermes desktop automation, especially permission and sign-in handling. PRAGMA: possible building block for client desktop-automation agents. Brand 9: no direct use.

praxis_lesson: Agent quality is increasingly set by the control layer around the model: DeReAct-style external gates, MIRA-style meta-reasoners and resume/recovery tooling all beat trusting a single prompt. Give every long-running Construct agent an outer loop that allocates work and verifies results, and audit free-tier dependencies before they disappear.
